_notes: Sheet 177 of the tournament savegame (8x4, CustomDeck key 177), read card by card from the image on 2026-11-22. CardID = 17700 + idx; 310 = character card (sheet 3, 10x7, index 10); the deck object holds 31 cards: the 30 playing cards and the character card (the catalog says card_ids [310, 17729]). Sheet 177 is shared: Houdini's character card is 17700 (another image), Rosie's loose rules card is 17700 and Pandora's seven Miseries are 17700-17706 (another deck): only deck.identity tells them apart (docs/card-identity.md).

Order on the sheet: What Large Hands You Have 0-1, What Big Ears You Have 2-3, Long Have I Sought You 4-6, What Big Eyes You Have 7-8, What's That In My Basket? 9-12, Once Upon a Time 13-14, Stones in the Belly 15-17, What a Terrible Big Mouth You Have 18-19, The Wolf's Skin 20-22, Never Leave the Path 23-24, Into the Woods 25-27, A Grimm Tale 28-29. Bands read from the card backs: LITTLE RED (Large Hands, Big Ears, Big Eyes, Basket, Terrible Big Mouth, Never Leave the Path, Into the Woods), HUNTSMAN (Long Have I Sought You, A Grimm Tale), ANY (Once Upon a Time, Stones in the Belly, The Wolf's Skin).

SLIPS in unmatched-memory found against the images: What Big Eyes You Have is VERSATILE 3 / BOOST 2 (memory says value 2); Stones in the Belly prints value 2 / BOOST 1 (memory has no value, and Ivan's note 'no printed value' came from it; the image shows a 2 in the purple banner). Every other value, boost, copy count and the 30 cards agree.

The symbol in the lower left corner of each card is the symbol the card shows when it is on top of the discard pile (the basket): wolf, rose or axe, or the star of What's That In My Basket? (wild). It is the tag `symbol:<x>` of each copy (`wild` for the star). The three copies of Into the Woods print ONE symbol each (rose, wolf, axe: idx 25, 26, 27), not three at once: unmatched-memory's title lists them together because the three copies differ. This makes Ivan's LR1 about Into the Woods moot (only the star and the starting Basket are wild); see docs/heroes/little-red-riding-hood.md.

Hero card 310 read from the image: LITTLE RED, MELEE, START HEALTH 14, MOVE 2, sidekick HUNTSMAN, RANGED, START HEALTH 9 (one). Little Red's Basket is a loose CardCustom (51f3b8, a sheet of its own, CardID 17600 of a one-image deck 176) in the inner bag: it is a component, not a card of the deck.
